## Design

### 2026-10-10 – 6:00-11:00 (-15 mins to eat dinner)

**5.75h**

6:00-11:00 (-15 mins to eat dinner)
- Installed symbol and footprint libraries to KiCad (opened KiCad for the first time)
-Created PCB design and schematic
- Learned how to place net labels and symbols as well as create wires, text, and boxes in schematics
-Spent a bajillion hours trying to properly wire/route everything (until 10 pm)
-Decorated PCB with text and images
